title: Malicious code in mikuhostt-baileys (npm)
description: The mikuhostt-baileys npm package is a malicious fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that covertly uses the installer's authenticated WhatsApp session to subscribe the account to WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher. This behavior occurs automatically 90 seconds after a WhatsApp socket connection is established, without user consent. The package does not exfiltrate credentials or maintain persistence but abuses the victim's account to inflate channel subscribers.
